newsitem.title: USA: Comdisco buys disaster recovery company.
newsitem.headline: Comdisco buys disaster recovery company.

text.p: Comdisco Inc on Tuesday said it acquired the assets and contracts of Exchange Resources Inc, a disaster recovery services company, for $2 million in cash.

Comdisco said Exchange Resources, which specializes in backing up computer systems on trading floors in the financial services industry, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on September 12. The company said Exchange had 1996 annualized revenues of $4.2 million.
Comdisco said it would hire remaining key employees based in Exchange's facilities in Rutherford, N.J., and Minnetonka, Minn.
Comdisco is a technology services company that provides disaster recovery, asset management, network services and leasing.
